description:
We are seeking an experienced Logistics Manager to lead and optimize logistics operations within a dynamic automotive manufacturing environment. This role is central to ensuring smooth production flow, high service levels, and strong alignment between customer demand, production planning, and material availability.


Qualifications & Experience

  • University degree;
  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the automotive or manufacturing industry;
  • Strong knowledge of logistics processes and production systems;
  • Proven experience with SAP and Supply Chain Management (SCM) principles;
  • Knowledge of transport legislation and customer-specific requirements;
  • Very good understanding of economic principles relevant to logistics and supply chain operations;
  • Proficiency in English, German is an advantage.

Professional Skills

  • End-to-end logistics and supply chain process expertise;
  • Production and capacity planning competence;
  • KPI management and performance optimization;
  • Inventory control and materials management;
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Proven leadership skills, including delegation, decision-making, motivation, and employee development;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Strong organizational and planning abilities;
  • Strategic thinking;
  • Effective negotiation techniques and conflict management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads and continuously develops the Logistics Department, ensuring high performance and cross-functional collaboration;
  • Develops and executes the organization’s logistics and supply chain strategy aligned with overall business objectives;
  • Coordinates and oversees logistics activities including production planning, customer service, order management, material flow, and operative logistics;
  • Ensures accurate and efficient production planning in line with agreed capacity, customer requirements, and material availability;
  • Develops and manages logistics budgets and control operational expenses;
  • Monitors and controls logistics spend, ensuring costs remain within approved budgets while maintaining service levels;
  • Makes sure that the customer requirement is directly correlated with the internal production plan and material procurement;
  • Identifies and manages logistics risks, including disruption planning, contingency strategies, and compliance exposure;
  • Collaborates with other departments in order to align logistics capabilities with growth plans;
  • Monitors and achieves key performance indicators (KPIs), including premium freight costs, Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO), on-time delivery, and backlog performance;
  • Analyzes data, prepares reports and proposes measures on logistics performance, KPIs;
  • Identifies the improvement potential by removing waste from the logistics processes;
  • Ensures proper implementation and execution of periodic inventory processes;
  • Leads, mentors, and develops the logistics team to build a high-performance, accountable, and engaged organization;
  • Defines clear roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations aligned with logistics and business objectivess
  • Establishes a culture of continuous improvement, safety, compliance, and customer focus across all logistics functions.
